description: Least-privilege permissions for the main window (docs/SECURITY.md §2), named one by one (no core:default): events for the IPC's typed events, and the window controls of the Windows title bar drawn by the UI (FR-052). Dialogs are opened from Rust, so the webview gets no dialog, filesystem, shell, http or opener permission. Checked by src-tauri/tests/security_config.rs.
